title_en: The Beloved Image Comics Series We're Taking Everyone Down With Us Gets a Stylish New Prequel Book Called In Good Hands With Bad Company
summary_en: Fans of the critically acclaimed Image Comics series We're Taking Everyone Down With Us should be stoked, because there's a lot more of the franchise in store for 2027.
body_en:
Matthew Rosenberg and Stefano Landini's We're Taking Everyone Down With Us has easily been one of Image Comics' biggest hits in recent years, and IGN is pleased to be able to reveal new details about the prequel spinoff, In Good Hands With Bad Company. The creators are reuniting for this one-shot special, which will then spawn an entire series of spinoff issues from different creative teams that will eventually lead into a full-blown We're Taking Everyone Down With Us sequel.
Check out the slideshow gallery below to see the cover art for In Good Hands With Bad Company #1:
In Good Hands With Bad Company #1 reunites Rosenberg and Landini. The creative team also includes artist Josh Hood (We Can Never Go Home), colorist Jason Wordie (Kaya, Duke), letterer Hassan Otsmane-Elhaou, and editors Eric Harburn and Steve Foxe. The issue features covers by Landini, Hood, and Alex Eckman-Lawn.
Here's the official summary for In Good Hands With Bad Company #1:
“I’m so excited to be returning to this world Stefano and I built,” said Rosenberg in a statement. “We always knew we had a lot more stories to tell with these characters and a lot more desire to see them do horrible things to each other. And it’s been a real joy to bring in some friends to help us do that for these one-shots while Stefano and I work on what the future holds for Rook, Annalise, and the Vitruvian.”
“Matt and I are ready, and while working on the new season, we’ve also decided to expand the circle,” added Landini. “What if our characters were the protagonists of short stories drawn by other colleagues too? In the We're Taking Everyone Down With Us universe, the rule is simple: no one saves themselves...we all go down together!”
In Good Hands With Bad Company #1 will be released on January 13, with a final order cutoff of November 30. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .
For more, check out our exclusive Star Wars/Marvel: Hope Assembles interview with writer Kevin Smith and learn more about DC's Absolute Justice crossover .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
